title: The Unholy Alliance battles the FBI
summary: Mikey Whipwreck and Tajiri find a new identity under the Sinister Minister. Their championship chase runs into Little Guido and Tony Mamaluke’s more calculating partnership.

chapters.title: The Unholy Alliance wins the tournament
chapters.result: Whipwreck and Tajiri win the vacant tag championships.
chapters.context: The tournament gives their unusual partnership its first championship payoff.

chapters.title: The FBI takes the titles the next night
chapters.result: Guido and Mamaluke defeat the Unholy Alliance for the tag titles.
chapters.context: The rapid reversal begins the new champions’ rivalry with Tajiri and Whipwreck.

chapters.title: Tajiri and Mikey win the two-out-of-three-falls match
chapters.result: The Unholy Alliance defeats the FBI.
chapters.context: By this point neither team holds the belts, but the rematch provides a late payoff to their rivalry.
